001package com.streamconverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamconverter.CommandResult;
004import com.streamconverter.StreamConverter;
005import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
006import com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamconverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
008import com.streamconverter.context.PipelineContext;
009import com.streamconverter.path.CSVPath;
010import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
011import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
012import java.io.IOException;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014import java.util.List;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017import org.slf4j.MDC;
018
019/**
020 * StreamConverterのMDC伝搬デモ
021 *
022 * <p>このデモでは、親スレッドで設定したMDC値がStreamConverter配下の 全コマンドに自動的に伝搬されることを示します。
023 */
024public class StreamConverterMDCDemo {
025  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamConverterMDCDemo.class);
026
027  /**
028   * Main method to demonstrate StreamConverter MDC propagation.
029   *
030   * @param args command line arguments (not used)
031   * @throws IOException if file operations fail
032   */
033  public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
034    logger.info("StreamConverter MDC Propagation Demo");
035
036    demonstrateBasicMDC();
037    demonstrateMultipleCommandsMDC();
038    demonstrateChildToChildPropagation();
039
040    logger.info("All demonstrations completed successfully!");
041  }
042
043  /** デモ1: 基本的なMDC伝搬 */
044  private static void demonstrateBasicMDC() throws IOException {
045    logger.info("Demo 1: Basic MDC Propagation");
046
047    // 親スレッドでMDCを設定
048    MDC.put("requestId", "REQ-DEMO-456");
049    MDC.put("userId", "demo-user");
050
051    try {
052      IStreamCommand command = (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out);
053      StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(command);
054
055      String testData = "id,name,department\n1,Alice,Engineering\n2,Bob,Marketing\n";
056      ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
057          new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
058      ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
059
060      logger.info("Executing pipeline with MDC propagation...");
061      List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
062
063      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
064      logger.info(
065          "Demo 1 completed. Results: {} commands, Output length: {} characters",
066          results.size(),
067          result.length());
068    } finally {
069      MDC.clear();
070    }
071  }
072
073  /** デモ2: コマンド間MDC伝搬（PipelineContext） */
074  private static void demonstrateChildToChildPropagation() throws IOException {
075    logger.info("Demo 2: Child-to-Child MDC Propagation via PipelineContext");
076
077    MDC.put("requestId", "REQ-CHILD-001");
078
079    try {
080      // Command A: ストリームデータからIDを抽出してPipelineContextに設定
081      IStreamCommand extractId =
082          (in, out) -> {
083            byte[] data = in.readAllBytes();
084            String content = new String(data, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
085
086            // 冒頭行からIDを抽出（シミュレーション）
087            String orderId = content.lines().findFirst().orElse("UNKNOWN");
088            PipelineContext.putShared("orderId", orderId);
089            logger.info("Command A: extracted orderId from stream");
090
091            out.write(data);
092          };
093
094      // Command B: TurboFilter経由でorderIdが自動的にMDCに反映される
095      IStreamCommand process =
096          (in, out) -> {
097            // ログ出力時にTurboFilterがPipelineContextの共有値をMDCにsyncする
098            // → このログにorderId が自動的に含まれる
099            logger.info("Command B: processing with orderId automatically in MDC");
100            in.transferTo(out);
101          };
102
103      StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(extractId, process);
104
105      String testData = "ORD-2026-0001\nitem1,100\nitem2,200\n";
106      ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
107          new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
108      ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
109
110      List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
111      logger.info("Demo 2 completed. {} commands executed", results.size());
112    } finally {
113      MDC.clear();
114    }
115  }
116
117  /** デモ3: 複数コマンドでのMDC伝搬 */
118  private static void demonstrateMultipleCommandsMDC() throws IOException {
119    logger.info("Demo 3: Multiple Commands with MDC Propagation");
120
121    MDC.put("requestId", "REQ-MULTI-789");
122
123    try {
124      String testData = "product,price,category\nLaptop,999.99,Electronics\nBook,19.99,Education\n";
125
126      // 複数のコマンドでパイプライン構築
127      IStreamCommand validator = (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out);
128      CsvNavigateCommand extractor =
129          CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("product"), new PassThroughRule());
130      IStreamCommand formatter = (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out);
131
132      StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(validator, extractor, formatter);
133
134      ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
135          new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
136      ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
137
138      logger.info("Executing multi-command pipeline with MDC propagation...");
139      List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
140
141      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
142      logger.info("Demo 3 completed. Results: {} commands executed", results.size());
143      logger.info("Final output: {}", result.trim());
144    } finally {
145      MDC.clear();
146    }
147  }
148}
